The ten finite permutation checks corroborate critical low-dimensional cases without replacing the proof.

value.rationale: The claim gives an exact natural local divisor invariant on every singular collision stratum of an oriented symmetric product and a sharp criterion for formal factoriality while all algebraic local rings are UFDs. This is useful for distinguishing formal divisor phenomena from Zariski divisor geometry, not a generic quotient-ring restatement. It applies simultaneously to all n≥2 and all d≥5, with nontrivial 2-/3-torsion boundary cases.
